# immich_tag (Resource)

Manages an Immich tag.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "immich_tag" "example" {
  name  = "Vacation"
  color = "#FF0000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the tag.

### Optional

- `color` (String) Hex color code for the tag.
- `parent_id` (String) Optional parent tag ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

### OpenTofu Import Block (Recommended)

```terraform
import {
  to = immich_tag.example
  id = "5678-abcd-1234"
}
```

### CLI Import

```terraform
tofu import immich_tag.example 5678-abcd-1234
```
